name: France
description:
The City of Light and much more, France captivates with art, wine, cuisine, and culture. From Paris to the Côte d'Azur, it offers timeless elegance, world-class museums, and a refined lifestyle.

## Key Highlights
- World-class art, museums, and cultural heritage
- Exquisite cuisine and wine traditions
- Timeless elegance and refined lifestyle
longdescription: France is a Western European nation with profound cultural influence globally, known as the world's most visited country. Paris, the capital, is often called the City of Light and is renowned for its beauty, art, architecture, romance, and influence. France is synonymous with art (Louvre Museum), fashion (haute couture), wine, cuisine, and refined culture. French gastronomy is UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage. French wine regions produce world's finest wines from Bordeaux, Burgundy, Champagne, and Provence. Paris offers unparalleled museums, galleries, theaters, and cultural institutions. The French Riviera (Côte d'Azur) is world-famous for beaches, towns like Monaco and Nice, and Mediterranean lifestyle. The economy is one of Europe's largest and most diversified. The education system is well-developed. Healthcare is excellent. Cost of living is high in Paris, particularly for housing. French is the official language; English proficiency varies, being lower in France than many European countries. French culture emphasizes elegance, philosophy, and joie de vivre. The French value work-life balance and extended vacation time. The country is politically stable with strong institutions. Immigration requires sponsorship typically. Challenges include expensive Paris living, French language importance, and bureaucratic complexity. France combines unmatched cultural heritage, culinary excellence, artistic traditions, Mediterranean beauty, sophisticated lifestyle, and global influence, making it ideal for those valuing culture, art, wine, and refined living despite high costs.

visas.name: France Family Reunification Visa
visas.description: France's family reunification visa allows the spouse and dependent children of a foreign national who has been legally resident in France for at least 18 months to join them for long-term residence.

visas.name: France Long-Stay Visitor Visa (VLS-TS)
visas.description: France's long-stay visitor visa (VLS-TS Visiteur) is ideal for retirees and financially independent non-EU nationals who wish to live in France without engaging in any professional activity.

Citizenship by Descent.desc: Children of French citizen parent(s) acquire French citizenship automatically. Ancestry-based claims available through succession.

Naturalization.desc:
**Requirements:** 5 years legal residence (EU/EEA: 3 years for workers), French language B1 level, knowledge of French culture/constitution, stable income.

**Processing:** Through Prefecture, 12-24 months. Selective process.

Spouse of French Citizen.desc: Spouses may apply after 2 years marriage with reduction to 4 years total residence requirement.

Birthright Citizenship.desc: Children born in France to French parent(s) acquire citizenship. Limited jus soli for children of non-citizens.

tax_advice:
- France has progressive income tax (0% to 45%)
- Corporate tax rate is 25% (reduced to 15% for small/medium enterprises)
- VAT at 20% (reduced rates of 10%, 5.5%, and 2.1%)
- Non-residents taxed on France-source income only
- Capital gains: 19% flat tax (plus social levies)
- Extensive use of tax rulings to determine favorable treatment
- New France requirement: substantial economic activity needed for residency
- French residents required to file worldwide assets (declaration of foreign accounts)
- Wealth tax (ISF) applies to certain high-net-worth individuals
local_tips:
- French essential outside Paris; English limited outside major cities/expat areas
- Bureaucracy complex and slow; French love of paperwork real; patience critical
- Cost of living reasonable outside Paris; Paris very expensive; budget €1,500-2,000/month Paris
- Healthcare excellent; mandatory registration; Sécurité Sociale system complex
- Work visa sponsorship required; freelancer status available for self-employed
- French culture values pessimism and critical thinking; learn to appreciate it
- Regional integration important; Paris expats can live expat bubble if not careful
